description.value: A la Mode is a gourmet pie café inside the Granville Island Public Market, founded in 1986 when Angus McKay brought his original homemade recipes from his restaurant bakeries. The café offers over 40 handmade sweet and savoury pies, artisan croissants, an espresso bar, bubble tea, and smoothies, with extensive dietary options including vegan and gluten-friendly menus. Featured in international travel guides, it has earned a loyal following among both locals and visitors to one of Vancouver's most-visited public markets.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (100 spaces) at 53m; rack at 83m. Total: 100 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms an active, operating café at #575-1689 Johnston St inside Granville Island Public Market, with phone and email matching OSM exactly. The site explicitly lists Vegetarian, Vegan, Gluten Friendly, and Sugar Free menu categories, and an online Shopify storefront plus Uber Eats/DoorDash integration confirms takeout capability. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities was found on the website.
concerns: OSM name 'A la Mode' differs in capitalisation from the website's primary branding 'A La Mode Pie'; OSM value retained per schema rules.
OSM address lacks postal code; website provides V6H 3R9, incorporated into the address field.
Bike parking and washroom availability not mentioned on website; Granville Island Public Market likely has both, but cannot be confirmed from available evidence.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established food destination (est. 1986) inside Granville Island Public Market with broad food offerings, substantial dietary accommodations, and takeout capability — a natural refuelling stop for cyclists visiting Granville Island.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website lists dedicated Vegetarian Savoury Pies, Vegan, Gluten Friendly, and Sugar Free menu sections. FAQ confirms all dessert pies are vegetarian, no lard is used, and separate vegan, gluten-free, and sugar-free menus exist. Facility is not fully gluten-free
